name: That Which Was Taken
description: A stone disk trapping Michiko's sister's spirit.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
timeline.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, then teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.
timeline.quote: Back at Minamo he freezes Mochi with his ice powers and drops the Taken One at his feet

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi steals Konda's stone trophy and escapes the hyozan oath with Night's Reach's help.
timeline.quote: With the Myojin of Night's Reach's help, Toshi was able to escape the bonds of the hyozan oath.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi escapes with the disk through the shadows against the myojin's wish; the disk punctures her mask, and he loses her blessings and his kanji abilities.
timeline.quote: She fled and Toshi was spat out of the shadows bereft of the myojin's blessings and even his kanji abilities.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko touches the disk, releasing Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
timeline.quote: Together, they destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A being, in a way a daughter of O-Kagachi, taken by Konda; Toshi uses it to make O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Entity captured by Konda, freed by Michiko and renamed Kyodai.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A stone disk trapping Michiko's sister's spirit.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
